In this video we cover:
Mahindra & Mahindra is acquiring a 58.96% stake in SML Isuzu for ₹555 crore to strengthen its presence in the commercial vehicle market. The deal is expected to help M&M diversify its portfolio into buses and medium-duty trucks, aiming to double its market share from 3% to 6% initially, and up to 20% by FY36. SML Isuzu, known for its light buses and trucks, will benefit from M&M’s nationwide distribution network and brand recognition. If executed well, the merger could position the combined entity as the fourth-largest player in India's bus and truck market.
